title: ACE-Trader: Adversarial Co-Evolution for Generator-Critic Trading Systems

claim.summary: ACE-Trader runs a Commit-Challenge-Revise loop between an LLM Trader and Red-Team, picks each role's memory with selectors trained online on memory-on versus memory-off net-return differences, and settles critiques and revisions against realized outcomes to build linked role-specific memories.

modules.name: Net-return-trained context-dependent memory selectors
modules.scope_reason: Selector inputs combine market and portfolio features, and labels come from net-return differences between memory-assisted and memory-free trading pipelines, so the mechanism is bound to the trading objective.
evidence_locators: PDF p.2; passage beginning "Each selector combines a frozen"

modules.name: Outcome-settled Trader and Red-Team memory co-evolution
modules.scope_reason: Critiques carry observable conditions and evaluation horizons that are settled against realized prices, and revision benefit is the net-return difference between portfolio plans, so the memory content is defined by trading outcomes.
